purpose: Determine whether externally observable control/presence constructs correspond to endogenous Pineland latent states, distinguishing direct, partial, and absent representation before any further historical use.

armed_presence.criterion: DIRECT if actor/locality/time presence is stored explicitly and can change through substantive processes.

government_administrative_presence.criterion: DIRECT_CONTINUOUS if government administrative control receives endogenous writes from governance/political production.

insurgent_shadow_governance.criterion: DIRECT_CONTINUOUS only if taxation/regulation/governance activity can endogenously build or decay the corresponding insurgent dimensions; initialized/inherited values alone are insufficient.

territorial_access_constraint.criterion: DIRECT only if civilian/organizational access restriction exists as a first-class latent state or process output; military/logistics route risk does not qualify.

synthetic_design.execution: one-shot baseline and one-shot event-boundary audit per seed

acceptance_and_classification_rules: Observer must be dynamics-invariant relative to an uninstrumented run for every seed.
Government administrative/legal/fiscal/social/expected writes must be observable in synthetic execution or source-path inventory.
Insurgent nonphysical dimensions are classified PARTIAL if only a strict subset has endogenous writers while others are initialized/inherited or merely read by downstream equations.
Territorial access constraint is classified ABSENT if no first-class civilian-access state/process exists; military route risk/interdiction cannot satisfy this construct.
A representation gap is a general-theory/model-construct diagnosis, not a historical-fit explanation and not authorization for a core edit during the active historical confrontation.
interpretation: A pass means the representation classification is identified. It does not mean every construct is adequately represented; PARTIAL or ABSENT is a valid scientific result.
